text: Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Solutions: software and services for detecting, preventing, and reporting financial crimes and suspicious transactions; AML; Anti-Money Laundering; Anti Money Laundering; KYC; Know Your Customer; CFT; Counter Terrorism Financing; Suspicious Transaction Reporting; Sanctions Screening; Customer Due Diligence; EDD; Enhanced Due Diligence
reasons: AML tenders are typically filed under broad IT or Consulting categories rather than a specific 'AML' category, so no clear category fit exists; extra terms like KYC and CFT are added because they are frequently used interchangeably or alongside AML in GeM tender titles.
